diffs.diff: header pin 5 (E): part says gnd, datasheet reading says io
diffs.evidence: Alps lists the EC11E15244B2 push switch as 'Single pole single throw (Push-on)', a passive two-terminal switch D-E with no driven output, so one terminal must be tied to GND for the other (D, read by a pulled-up GPIO) to see it close; modelling E as gnd is the correct wiring role, while the second reading's io role only reflects that the bare terminal is unlabelled.
